A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores

  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Integridade Sênior (Inspeção) que será responsável pela gestão da integridade e inspeção de dutos e equipamentos, incluindo identificação, mensuração e proposição de mitigação, garantindo a segurança operacional, a confiabilidade do sistema de transporte e o atendimento às regulamentações vigentes, com foco em Proteção Catódica e desejável conhecimento em NR‑13/SPIE.

Responsabilidades

Analisar resultados de levantamentos de campo (CIPS, DCVG, PCM/A-Frame, entre outros) e propor ações corretivas e preventivas.

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia.

Oferecemos

  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Bolsa-auxílio e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado: Cartão flexível Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional e Odontológico Privian Master, Seguro de vida, Previdência Privada, Total Pass, Auxílio-medicamentos pelo Vidalink, Vale-presente, Vale-transporte, Ticket de Natal, Auxílio creche/babá e PLR.

  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.

  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor e Business Partner: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com o Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.

Atua em diagnósticos mecânicos, elétricos, eletrônicos, híbridos e, quando aplicável, em veículos elétricos a bateria. Deve interpretar manuais técnicos, seguir normas de segurança e ambientais, e utilizar corretamente ferramentas e equipamentos homologados, contribuindo diretamente para a satisfação do cliente e o desempenho do pós-vendas da concessionária.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em veículos BYD conforme ordem de serviço.
  • Efetuar troca de óleo e filtros (óleo do motor, ar do motor, ar-condicionado, combustível).
  • Executar alinhamento e balanceamento de rodas com equipamentos adequados.
  • Diagnosticar falhas mecânicas e eletrônicas utilizando scanner automotivo homologado pela montadora.
  • Executar serviços mecânicos nos sistemas:
  • Suspensão: substituição de amortecedores, bandejas, buchas, molas, pivôs e bieletas.

  • Transmissão: substituição de homocinéticas, semieixos, retentores e verificação de fluido do câmbio.
  • Interpretar manuais técnicos e diagramas elétricos.
  • Cumprir os procedimentos de segurança e ambientais estabelecidos pela montadora.
  • Preencher corretamente OSs, apontando serviços realizados, peças trocadas e tempo aplicado.
  • Participar de treinamentos técnicos BYD e manter-se atualizado sobre novas tecnologias.
  • Utilizar corretamente os equipamentos, ferramentas especiais e EPI’s.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • ✔️ - Ensino Médio Completo.

title: Vice President, Auditor

Vice President, Auditor – Internal Audit

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting‑edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Auditor to join our Internal Audit team. This role is located in Rio de Janeiro.

Responsibilities

  • Participating in risk‑based audits covering Fund Administration, Custody, and Corporate Functions, from end‑to‑end planning through reporting, in line with Internal Audit methodologies and standards.
  • Executing thorough and accurate testing to assess adherence to internal policies, audit standards, and applicable Brazilian and global regulatory requirements.
  • Identifying and promoting opportunities for the use of data analytics, automation, and AI to enhance audit coverage and efficiency.
  • Leads risk‑focused planning, fieldwork and reporting, in accordance with Internal Audit policies, methodologies, and standards to identify meaningful issues, risks and other exposures.
  • Responsible for ensuring testing is adequate and accurate to allow an evaluation of adherence to company policies and procedures, audit methodologies, and all applicable regulations.
  • Demonstrates skills and understanding of businesses and processes through flowcharting, work papers, analysis, issue identification and discussions with management and auditees.

  • Applies advanced analytical problem‑solving skills and leads others in solving complex issues and identifying innovative solutions.
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders across the Brazil businesses, second line functions, and global Internal Audit teams.
  • Apply knowledge of financial institutions and regulations daily, participate in relevant training, and share insights with the audit team.
  • Contributing to continuous risk assessment and monitoring activities, remaining alert to emerging risks and regulatory developments impacting the Brazil platform.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience or hands‑on interest in applying data analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and emerging technologies to audit activities, including the ability to interpret and challenge analytics outputs to drive risk‑based insights.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and work experience required.
  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline.
  • Solid experience in Internal Audit or the relevant specialty area (Risk, Compliance, or Controls), with the ability to operate within a global audit framework.

  • Professional certifications (e.g., CIA, CPA, CFA) are preferred.

Benefits and Rewards

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay‑for‑performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

Awards

For over 230 years, the people of BNY Mellon have been at the forefront of finance, expanding the financial markets while supporting investors throughout the investment lifecycle. Whether providing financial services for institutions, corporations or individual investors, clients count on the people of BNY Mellon across time zones and in 35 countries and more than 100 markets. title: Coordenador de Planejamento e Controle
description:
O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.

Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .

Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.

Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.

Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.

Missão do cargo:

Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Planejamento e Controle para atuar de forma estratégica no processo de FP&A, com forte integração às áreas operacionais e papel essencial no suporte à tomada de decisão da alta administração, por meio de análises econômico-financeiras robustas e modelos financeiros complexos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar e acompanhar os processos de planejamento estratégico, orçamento anual, revisões periódicas (forecast) e controle orçamentário;
  • Desenvolver, estruturar e manter modelos financeiros complexos, incluindo:
  • Projeções financeiras de longo prazo;
  • Modelos de viabilidade econômico-financeira;
  • Simulações de cenários (sensibilidade, stress, upside e downside);
  • Modelos contratuais com múltiplos indexadores e diferentes estruturas de reajuste;
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas operacionais, contratos, engenharia e comercial, traduzindo dados técnicos e operacionais em impactos financeiros claros e acionáveis;
  • Apoiar negociações contratuais, revisões de preços, pleitos e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;
  • Estruturar, acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) financeiros e operacionais;

Requisitos técnicos

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em Planejamento e Controle Financeiro (FP&A);
  • Domínio avançado de modelagem financeira, especialmente em Excel (ou ferramentas equivalentes), incluindo:
  • Experiência com contratos de longo prazo, concessões ou setores intensivos em capital (infraestrutura, saneamento, resíduos, energia ou similares);

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Experiência em empresas de infraestrutura, saneamento, meio ambiente ou serviços públicos;
  • Vivência com indexadores econômicos, reajustes contratuais e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;

Atuamos na Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados.

Nosso compromisso é transformar a forma como os resíduos são geridos, criando valor ambiental, social e econômico a partir do que antes era descartado. Onde outros veem fim, nós enxergamos recomeço: onde tudo tenha a chance de se regenerar.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

We are recruiting an Associate General Counsel for Faculty Affairs and Employment or a Senior Associate General Counsel, Faculty Affairs, Employment & Labor Relations. The selected incumbent provides in-house legal counsel and strategic collaboration with Howard University and Howard University Hospital executives, academic administrators and Office of Human Resources professionals regarding a comprehensive range of employment and labor relations matters. Advises and represents the University and Hospital on employment matters including but not limited to wrongful termination, discrimination, workers' compensation and wage and hour claims brought by University and Hospital employees, including providing advice and counseling to University executives, academic administrators and Office of Human Resources professionals to ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations as well as advising on such matters in litigation.

Provides counsel and legal sufficiency review of legal documents, settlement agreements, discipline, suspensions, terminations, workplace policies, handbooks and other documents concerning employees. Supervises and manages outside counsel in employment and labor relations matters.

A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have substantial labor experience, in addition to a strong foundation in an employment related practice. The Senior Associate General Counsel will provide in-house legal counsel services and represents Howard University as the supervisor of the primary in-house labor attorney handling all matters involving the bargaining units of the University and Hospital and related collective bargaining agreements.

Supervisory Accountability

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will not have any direct supervisory accountability, but is expected to be primarily responsible for all employment and faculty related matters with a high level of autonomy.

The Senior Associate General Counsel will supervise all employment-related and labor-related work of other staff attorneys. Serves as supervisor of other in-house counsel who will be first chair on labor, collective bargaining and union matters.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, and staff of the University. External contacts include federal and local courts and administrative agencies including EEOC, OHR, DOL and OWH.

Principal Accountabilities

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have primary responsibilities to provide in-house legal advice, interpretation, and representation in a broad range of legal issues with employment related matters with knowledge of the labor process. In addition, a candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel position will have supervisory responsibility for labor matters, including but not limited to representation in government agency investigations, grievances, arbitrations, and in cases before the National Labor Relations Board.

Responsibilities include reviewing and drafting workplace handbooks, policies and guidelines for legal sufficiency; providing review and recommendations regarding various regulatory and compliance matters.

Other responsibilities include conducting formal training on EEO, wage & hour, mandated leave benefits, union representation, whistleblower, and other pertinent employment and labor law topics for new hires, current employees, and leadership.

The incumbent also prepares legal documents such as offer letters, academic appointment contracts, settlement agreements, termination agreements, collective-bargaining agreements, employment agreements. Also responsible for overseeing preparation of responses to information requests directed at Howard University or Hospital, advisory memoranda and documents relating to collective bargaining agreements, litigation matters or agency proceedings.

Represents the University in legal and quasi-legal proceedings, including the District of Columbia and Federal courts and before government agencies on employment and labor relations matters and on other legal matters. Represents the University in hearings, meetings and in other forums related to University legal matters, as needed.

Drafts and negotiates commitments involving University resources; principally contracts, settlements, other agreements and statements of University policy for subsequent approval by the General Counsel and University Officers.

Reviews documents for other University offices for legal implications and possible legal policy questions.

Responds to University officials' request for advice in areas of assigned responsibility.

Serves as office resource on updates and developments in employment and labor law.

Provides legal expertise and otherwise represents the office in meetings with University officials and individuals outside of the University.

Provides counseling, advice, and guidance to academic administrators, supervisors and other management officials on faculty and staff conduct and performance problems.

Provides assistance with conflict resolution, as requested. Furnishes recommendations to academic administrators, department heads, managers, and supervisors concerning possible courses of action in handling employee problems and concerns. Reviews employee discipline and discharge matters and makes recommendation for appropriate course of action.

Reviews statistics and surveys and prepares analyses for review by the General Counsel. Reviews periodic utilization reports and develops appropriate management responses. Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

Detailed knowledge of federal and local laws applicable to employment and labor relations, and judicial and administrative agency systems and procedures.

Ability to conduct and manage adversarial proceedings on behalf of the University and Hospital before courts and administrative agencies.

Ability to plan, direct and conduct independent legal research and related analyses on a variety of labor and employment law topics.

Ability to participate effectively in fact-finding investigations, present findings and develop related recommendations.

Ability to articulate the University's position, listen and negotiate effectively.

Superior verbal and written communication skills.

Job Purpose

The Senior People Operations Officer serves as the College’s principal operational administrator for all HR-, payroll-, and hiring-related transactions. This role ensures the accuracy, compliance, and timely processing of personnel actions for faculty, staff, adjuncts, student employees, wage workers, and stipend-supported personnel. The incumbent functions as the College’s primary point of coordination between CEA leadership, HR, Payroll, the Office of the Provost, and departmental administrators. This is not an HR strategic role; instead, it is a senior-level operational and transactional position responsible for end‑to‑end workflow execution, Workday processing, onboarding, offboarding, and compliance.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for supervising the Budget Coordinator, Administrative III. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and evaluates work performed. Makes merit and promotion recommendations to the Dean and ensures professional development alignment with institutional expectations.

Nature And Scope

The Senior People Operations Officer interacts daily with academic departments, program directors, faculty, HR Business Partners, the Budget Office, Payroll, and the Office of the Provost. The incumbent must exercise a high degree of accuracy and judgment in handling sensitive personnel information, navigating complex approval processes, and ensuring compliance with University policy, hiring standards, and audit expectations.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as the College’s senior Workday transaction specialist for all hires, job changes, faculty terminations, PAPs, compensation changes, funding changes, and academic appointments.
  • Coordinate all job posting requests with HR Recruiting and ensure funding alignment prior to submission.
  • Draft and monitor term sheets, offer letters (where applicable), hiring packets, and background check requirements.
  • Manage onboarding workflows including I‑9, tax documentation, direct deposit, employee access, and new employee orientation tracking.
  • Initiate and track offboarding workflows for employees, adjunct faculty, and student workers.
  • Ensure accurate student hiring through FRFs, HAFs, wage-hire classifications, and Workday setup.
  • Maintain weekly hiring and transaction status reports for CEA leadership.
  • Conduct monthly HR and payroll compliance audits including cost allocations, active/inactive positions, and pending transactions.
  • Provide training and guidance to department administrators, chairs, and coordinators on Workday processes and personnel workflows.
  • Maintain and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for hiring, onboarding, terminations, PAPs, and Workday routing.
  • Liaise with HR, Payroll, and the Office of the Provost to resolve transactional issues and ensure timely processing.
  • Serve as subject‑matter expert for Workday HR and Workday Finance functionality relevant to personnel transactions.
  • Provide people‑data inputs to the Assistant Dean for reporting and planning (not financial analysis).
  • Manage confidential personnel information in accordance with University policies.

Core Competencies

  • Demonstrated ability to provide executive-level financial and operational guidance in a complex academic environment.
  • Deep knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, accounting controls, and resource stewardship.
  • Ability to interpret policy, influence adoption, and lead change with diplomacy and clarity in evolving systems.
  • Ability to supervise, develop, mentor, and evaluate staff performance and ensure accountability.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex financial and operational issues clearly.
  • Skilled in Workday Financials, procurement systems, and advanced spreadsheet and reporting tools.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Business Administration, or related field (required)
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience working in higher‑education operations.
  • Workday HR and Workday Finance familiarity.
  • Experience working with academic departments.
  • Administrative operations experience
  • Proficiency in Workday HR required.
  • Proficiency in Workday Finance preferred.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and shared workflow systems.
  • Ability to run reports, analyze personnel data, and maintain accurate records.

$20,000-$30,000

title: Product Specialist - Rio de Janeiro
description:
Job Description

Biocomposites is an international medical devices company that engineers, manufactures, and markets world leading products for use in infection management in bone and soft tissue. Based in Keele, UK, it has global operations across Europe, USA, Argentina, Canada, China, and India. Biocomposites is a world leader in the development of innovative calcium compounds and bone cements for surgical use. Its products regenerate bone and target infection risks across a variety of specialties, including musculoskeletal infection, orthopaedics, trauma, spine, foot and ankle, podiatry, and sports injuries. Biocomposites products are now used in over one million procedures per annum and sold in more than 100 countries around the world.

The Role

The Biocomposites Product Specialist’s primary goal is to drive compliant sales growth of the Biocomposites’ product portfolio across our core specialties of orthopedics, trauma, spine, and foot and ankle in priority target accounts. This will be achieved by motivating, educating and supporting the appropriate distributor sales representatives in their sales activities including product training, hospital and surgeon target selection and hands‑on, in‑field sales support. It will also include regularly travelling to target hospitals to engage with surgeons, peri‑operative teams, and hospital staff directly to promote correct product use and adoption. The position reports directly to the Country Manager.

Responsibilities

  • Achieve sales revenue targets by product and specialty in assigned Region.
  • Drive adoption in existing accounts and new users in hospitals within assigned territory. This will be achieved by directly selling to targeted surgeons as well as educating, supporting, and selling through local distribution teams.
  • Exhibit confidence in product knowledge and science to handle competitive threats.
  • Leverage data and local insight to prioritize local territory needs and activities.
  • Utilize business planning tools, data and information to effectively work the territory while achieving goals through set quarterly MBOs.
  • Enhance relationships with key stakeholders within distributor network to influence resource allocation and prioritize focus on Biocomposites’ products.
  • Ensure all distributor sales representatives sell compliantly and use our approved product messaging.
  • Provide continuous training and education to all distributor sales representatives in all vertical markets.
  • Identify and engage new distribution partners in our key vertical markets.
  • Regularly update distributor network on market conditions, challenges, product innovations, competition and pricing, as directed by Region Sales Manager.
  • Provide surgeon product feedback and identify surgeon challenges and opportunities to inform new product development.
  • Demonstrate OR and product competency to assist surgeons and peri‑operative team with technical guidance.
  • Routinely assist distribution with product expertise and support during sales calls.
  • Provide product in‑services and continuing education seminars to hospital staff.
  • Cultivate relationships with key surgeons, residents, fellows and KOL’s, within geography.
  • Support local customer dinner meetings and scientific exchanges.
  • Support Region Sales Manager in business planning.
  • Achieve quarterly territory Objectives as directed by Region Sales Manager.
  • Clinician and Distributor continuing education via sales trainings, current medical journals and clinical papers.
  • Timely and accurate expense reporting by way of Concur.
  • Ability to travel and conduct overnight stays within the geography as needed.
  • Ability to travel to US headquarters in Wilmington, NC for business meetings as needed.

Requirements

  • 3-5 years of documented medical or B2B sales success grounded in sales process training.
  • Advanced level of English.
  • Documented sales success and career progression.
  • Demonstration of competency in presenting technical information.
  • Ability to work with highly diverse groups.
  • Ability to present and educate provided materials.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Documented ability to influence decision makers.
  • Medical Device/Orthopedics Industry experience.
  • Basic knowledge of human anatomy is preferred.
  • Understanding of Hospital OR policy and procedures preferred.
  • Highly organized with exceptional follow‑up.
  • Computer skills, CRM skills, and ability to utilize technology to aid in Territory Management.
  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Resides within the geographical territory.
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable vehicle.
  • Background check and drug screening.

What do we offer?

Competitive salary and benefits! With us, you will receive a competitive salary package and benefits.

We grow talent. At Biocomposites we create opportunities to thrive and grow.

One Biocomposites - team spirit & engagement. Our culture is important, and we strive to create engaged and inclusive global teams that encourage colleagues to share their diverse perspectives and opinions.

Who do we look for?

People Who Are Passionate About What We Do.

People who are open minded to evolving the way we work.

People who can work together to transform outcomes and change lives.

O que buscamos

  • Formação superior completa, com sólida base profissional adquirida em ambientes comerciais ou de campo.

O Rio de Janeiro é uma praça altamente competitiva e crítica, o perfil ideal para essa região combina energia comercial, resiliência, organização e foco em resultado, com maturidade para atuar em um ambiente exigente, dinâmico e altamente exposto.

Nosso compromisso com a Diversidade e Inclusão

No Grupo Campari acreditamos que criar impacto juntos passa pela valorização da diversidade em todas as suas formas. Para nós, a diversidade é uma fonte de crescimento e inovação. O Grupo Campari acredita que uma remuneração justa e oportunidades iguais são essenciais para o bem-estar, o empoderamento e o engajamento dos funcionários. Nosso compromisso com a equidade salarial nos levou a conquistar a Certificação de Pagamento Justo pela Fair Pay Workplace, uma organização independente dedicada a reduzir disparidades salariais baseadas em gênero, raça e suas interseções.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Functions

To provide coordination of client-centered services that link clients with substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health with coordinated care and psychosocial services.

Working closely and collaboratively with the HUH inpatient and Consultation-Liaison and Addiction Medicine Consult services and the ambulatory Mental Health Clinic (Behavioral Health Clinic) teams, the Care Coordinator assesses clients’ needs and support systems; facilitates timely, coordinated access to and continuation of medically appropriate substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health care health and support services; assists in expediting appropriate discharge from inpatient facilities, as medically appropriate, and assists in preventing unnecessary hospitalizations; and establishes and maintains relations with case managers, healthcare providers, social services and other agency representatives to bridge the gaps between health, social service, entitlements and other systems.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assists in development and implements protocols for coordinating the substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health services for individual clients or patients with substance use or co-occurring psychiatric and substance use disorders.
  • Provides care coordination services to a caseload of patients/clients, as assigned by the PI, Project Director, or Care Manager Coordinator.
  • Operates as a liaison between the Departments of Psychiatry and Community and Family Medicine, Social Work and the DC Department of Health and other community groups.
  • Ensures that patients receive necessary follow-up substance use or psychiatric disorder treatment and medical treatments.
  • May accompany patients to the initial or follow-up visits and may help arrange transportation and scheduling of appointments.
  • Conducts intake and follow up assessments of clients’/patients’ behavioral health and medical/functional status; structural vulnerabilities; psychological; educational; financial; and individual support needs.
  • Reviews all initial client bio-psychosocial assessments and reassessments.
  • Attends department trainings and meetings relevant in ongoing effort to increase knowledge and skills to work effectively with clients.Attends annual and mandatory compliance Program training, including the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Privacy training, maintains adherence to the Health Sciences Compliance Program, the Howard University Code of Ethics and the Health Sciences Standards of Conduct.
  • Works on behalf of patients receiving medications for opioid use disorder treatment to improve the system of care by identifying service gaps and identifying services that are needed and ensuring that these services are provided in a courteous and dignified manner.
  • Maintains confidentiality of patients, their families and the staff.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of the care needed for individuals receiving MOUD or other substance use disorder treatment.
  • Knowledge of community resources to establish referral systems with community agencies to facilitate coordinated management plans for patients and their families.
  • Ability to express ideas clearly using appropriate language in communicating with a wide range of health, socioeconomic, and cultural groups.
  • Competence in both oral and written English.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with clients and their family members and other treatment or service providers; physicians, staff, University and Hospital personnel, and the general public.
  • Proficiency in both oral and written English.

Minimum Requirements

A Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, or a related field, or 2 or more years of experience in the field.

$46,700 - $52,700

  • Tornar o cuidado em saúde mais humano e acessível.

  • Usar a tecnologia como aliada para melhorar a experiência e os resultados em saúde.

  • Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência.

title: Referee Operations Manager
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Under the guidance of the FIFA Refereeing (Zurich) and Team Services (FIFA27), the Referee Operations Manager will lead the planning and delivery of all referee operations during FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ and related refereeing events. The role is to ensure the excellence of all services required for match officials, fully aligned with FIFA’s Refereeing Requirements, and to guarantee seamless coordination between FIFA Refereeing, Local Team Services and all relevant functional areas. The Referee Operations Manager will be based in the FIFA 27 headquarters in Rio de Janeiro during the planning stage and at the Referee Base Camp during tournament time.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure that all operational plans, services, logistics and procedures for Referee Services fully comply with FIFA Refereeing Requirements, delivering the highest standards of service quality to match officials.
  • Operationalise technical and operational needs from FIFA Refereeing into practical, efficient and integrated operational solutions.
  • Lead cross‑functional coordination with all relevant functional areas (FAs) to ensure full integration of Referee Services into tournament operations.
  • Represent Referee Services in operational meetings, workshops, and multi‑stakeholder sessions, ensuring alignment, follow‑up of action points, and consistent internal communication.
  • Coordinate closely with FIFA Refereeing, FIFA Team Services and FIFA27 Team Services for all operational and administrative matters.
  • Assist in preparing and refining Referee Services operational concepts, policies, procedures and service plans.
  • Drive operational readiness for all referee‑related events, including workshops, seminars, test events, inspection visit or any other preparatory activities.
  • Act as the dedicated Refereeing representative for stadium and training site operational planning, ensuring full integration of referee‑specific requirements.
  • Lead the planning and delivery of VAR referee operations at the International Broadcast Center, in coordination with Technology, Broadcast Operations and VAR leadership.
  • Organize the FIFA Referee Cup and Pre‑competition Seminar prior to the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™.
  • Work closely with Workforce, Volunteers and HR on planning, recruiting, onboarding and training temporary staff and volunteers dedicated to Referee Services.
  • Identify, secure and coordinate local football teams to participate in daily practical training sessions with referees.
  • Prepare and deliver training materials, operational manuals and readiness exercises for Referee Services staff and volunteers.
  • Monitor the Referee Services budget in close coordination with Team Services, ensuring efficient and responsible use of resources.
  • Lead the overall project planning for Referee Services, managing timelines, milestones and deliverables across all team members.
  • Based at the Referee Base Camp, the Referee Operations Manager will transition to a Referee Liaison Officer (RLO) role and will be responsible for:
  • Reporting to and assisting FIFA Refereeing, as required, with all local arrangements (matches, training sessions, meetings, spectating referees, etc).
  • Cooperating with all FAs and service providers to support referees and FIFA Refereeing daily.
  • Coordinating the local players requested for the practical training sessions with the referees.
  • Exchanging information, in particular any last‑minute changes to the daily program, with training site authorities and all FAs involved in the referees’ daily operations.
  • Organizing social activities for the FIFA Refereeing delegation team during the competition, as required.
  • Supervising and coordinating the Referee Services support staff, including the Venue Referee Liaison Officers and volunteers at each stadium.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Excellent communicator with strong planning, organizational and administrative skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to consistently deliver at a high standard.
  • Able to work closely and collaboratively with others, while being self‑motivated and able to work independently.
  • Able to manage a group of people working on the same projects and, as required, coordinate people in other functional areas to contribute to projects.
  • Capable of making decisions using problem‑solving skills and exercising sound judgment to achieve results.
  • Be very dynamic, stress‑resistant, motivated, excellent interpersonal and problem‑solving skills.
  • Comfortable working in an international, demanding and changing environment.
  • Able to adapt to and work well with people of other cultures and backgrounds.
  • Able to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain experienced and less experienced employees.
  • High energy levels, exceptional planning and organizational skills, strong negotiation and facilitation skills, excellent communication and presentation skills and positive relationship management abilities.
  • The right to work in Brazil.
  • Portuguese and English are mandatory, and Spanish is a great plus.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Senior Manager, Ticketing Operations
description:
Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organizationally to the Head of Ticketing the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager will work closely with the FIFA Ticketing team in Zurich to ensure the planning, implementation, and delivery of the ticketing operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. This role will be responsible for managing the ticketing operations at the stadiums and all ticketing facilities in the host country. Further, this role will oversee the creation and maintenance of seating maps in the ticketing system, as well as the assignment of ticket holders to seats in accordance with FIFA policies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the Ticketing Operations team in Brazil in the overall tournament planning, ensuring the team has the guidance, resources, and support required to deliver their roles successfully.
  • Foster strong collaboration within the local team and with the Ticketing team in Zurich to ensure consistent operational alignment.
  • Implement system configuration according to the specifications set by the Zurich team, maintaining accuracy and consistency across all platforms.
  • Oversee and manage the ticketing inventory, including the creation, maintenance, and continuous updating of seating plans for all host venues in the ticketing system.
  • Plan, prepare, and supervise the full on‑site ticketing operation, including the setup and management of all required infrastructure and equipment.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain ticketing policies and procedures to ensure operational excellence and compliance with organizational standards.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination with other functional areas as well as the host stadium to support a seamless event delivery.
  • Oversee all electronic access control operations in the host venues, ensuring proper configuration, integration, and match‑day readiness.
  • Plan, schedule, and conduct site visits as required to assess operational needs, validate infrastructure, and coordinate with venue stakeholders.
  • Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events as required.

YOUR PROFILE

Education / Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in ticketing operations for major sports events, venues, or entertainment properties.
  • Experience delivering ticketing operations for multi‑venue events or international tournaments is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with ticketing platforms and access control technologies.
  • Strong operational planning and stakeholder coordination skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast‑paced event environment with multiple deadlines.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Native‑level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued.

Skills & Competencies

  • Leadership and team management
  • Operational planning and execution
  • Stakeholder management
  • Problem solving and decision making
  • Communication and coordination
  • Attention to detail
  • Risk management mindset

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel to host cities.
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time.
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Analista de Produto Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

Buscamos pessoas comunicativas, determinadas, que gostem de gente e tenham ambição de crescer junto com uma das maiores joalherias do país .

Procuramos um(a) Analista de Produto Pleno com forte visão de negócio, senso estético e perfil analítico para atuar de forma estratégica na gestão do portfólio de produtos. Esse profissional será responsável por acompanhar o ciclo de vida dos produtos, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e inovação e garantir que as decisões estejam alinhadas às metas comerciais e à proposta de valor da empresa.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gestão do portfólio de produtos: acompanhar o desempenho comercial e de margem, propondo ações de mix, descontinuação ou ajustes de preço.
  • Análise de mercado e concorrência: monitorar tendências, lançamentos e posicionamento competitivo, gerando insights para decisões de sortimento e inovação.
  • Cadastro de produtos no sistema: garantir a correta inserção e atualização de informações técnicas e comerciais, incluindo descrições, medidas, custos, composição e dados para o site.
  • Gestão de pedidos de compra: emitir pedidos, acompanhar aprovações, controlar envios e atuar em interface com o time de supply chain para assegurar entregas dentro do prazo e dentro da verba de compra planejada.
  • Negociação com fornecedores: buscar continuamente os melhores custos, prazos e condições comerciais, mantendo o equilíbrio entre qualidade, rentabilidade e posicionamento de marca.
  • Desenvolvimento de novos produtos: atuar em conjunto com áreas de design, compras, marketing e operações para garantir que novos produtos sejam relevantes, rentáveis e entreguem a qualidade esperada.
  • Planejamento de lançamentos: definir estratégias de entrada no mercado, pricing, metas de vendas e posicionamento junto ao time de marketing e comercial.
  • Gestão de indicadores: acompanhar KPIs, margem, giro e cobertura de estoque, elaborando planos de ação quando necessário.
  • Relacionamento interdepartamental: fazer interface constante com times de marketing, supply chain, comercial, e-commerce e visual merchandising, garantindo coerência e execução das estratégias de produto.
  • Apoio à liderança: contribuir com análises estratégicas e apresentações executivas para suportar decisões de negócio e roadmap de produtos.
  • Gestão do ciclo de vida: propor ações para maximizar o desempenho de cada produto — desde o lançamento até o eventual encerramento.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo em administração, economia, engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar na Barra da Tijuca - Rio de Janeiro (híbrido);
  • Excel avançado;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Power Bi será um diferencial.

Benefícios

  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Vale-transporte;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Gympass;
  • Happy Day;
  • Casual Friday;
  • Desconto especiais em produtos da marca;
  • Desconto em faculdades parceiras;
  • Código Colaborador;
  • Possibilidade de crescimento.
  • Todas as vagas desta empresa aceitam candidatura PCD.

Somos a Monte Carlo Joias. Onde tudo pode ser extraordinário. Uma rede de joalherias que torna momentos inesquecíveis com luxo e design. Inauguramos nossa primeira loja em 1981 e hoje somos uma das maiores joalherias do país com aproximadamente 50 lojas em todos as regiões do Brasil. Somos mais de 500 colaboradores entre escritório, lojas, fábrica e assistência técnica (DAT). Valorizamos pessoas que tem brilho nos olhos e que está sempre buscando entregar a melhor experiência para o nosso cliente. Buscamos pessoas que tenham Visão de Dono , sendo comprometidas e apaixonadas pelo nosso negócio, que sejam Simples e descomplicadas. Pessoas inconformadas, Criativas no dia a dia e que adoram de colocar a mão na massa e aprender fazendo. Somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos e pela Nossa Gente . Desenvolvemos e mantemos os talentos que buscam desafios reais e que querem crescer e apresentar seus resultados com foco no Nosso Cliente . Acreditamos que trabalhando juntos chegamos mais longe e podemos alcançar o nosso propósito que é Celebrar quem escolhe brilhar!

title: Accounting Supervisor
description:
Be part of a new era in communications, transforming connectivity with Eutelsat Group – the world’s first GEO-LEO integrated global satellite operator.

As a leader in satellite communications, we provide global connectivity solutions - connecting businesses, communities, and governments around the world. We can connect you at on land, at sea and in the air. We also deliver broadcast television channels and packages, transmitting vital news reports around the world.

With Eutelsat Group You’ll Get To:

  • Pioneer the future of Space Technology
  • Bring connectivity to remote frontiers
  • Collaborate with customer-centric experts
  • Embrace cultural diversity in our global team

In a dynamic industry where passion drives our teams to make a difference to become the most trusted partner for global satellite connectivity, you will elevate your skills in a stretching, rewarding, and meaningful environment. At Eutelsat Group, we’re united by inclusion and diversity, striving for gender balance and social responsibility, on Earth and in Space.

Why Eutelsat Group?

  • Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion: With colleagues from over 75 countries, we embrace our global DNA and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We are proud that one-third of our executive team and 60% of our board are represented by women.
  • Ways of Working That Drive Us : As "One Team," we work collaboratively towards shared goals, with customer-centricity, respect, and inclusivity as our guiding principles.
  • Sustainability at Our Core: At Eutelsat Group, sustainability is more than just a word; it’s woven into our strategy. We’re dedicated to balancing social, environmental, and economic growth — both on Earth and in space.
  • Work-Life Balance: We offer flexible schedules and hybrid/remote work options to help you balance your personal and professional life. At Eutelsat Group, we are committed to supporting your well‑being and ensuring you have the flexibility you need to succeed both at work and at home.

Ready to grow with us? Apply today and help us build a more inclusive, sustainable future in the world of satellite technology

Job Overview

We are looking for an enthusiastic and skilled Accounting supervisor to join our team and play a critical role in the quality of the financial information of our subsidiaries located in Brazil . In this position, you’ll work closely with Accounting director and Tax director (located in Mexico) , contributing directly to our ongoing projects and initiatives. This is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact within an organization that values growth, teamwork, and professional development.

Who You Are:

Certified Public Accountant with strong technical accounting knowledge, 5+ years of experience with an international Enterprises or Audit within a Big 4 Firms, ability to work effectively with little supervision, focus on results and excellent ability to follow up, excellent communication and problem solving skills.

What You’ll Do:

  • Responsible for providing truthful and timely monthly balance information for the subsidiaries located in Brazil (Rio de Janeiro).
  • Responsible for the revenue reporting in coordination with team of revenue controlling.
  • Review that revenue- cost with intercompany comply with percentage set up in the contracts.
  • Perform analysis of the P&L monthly variations against the previous month and the previous year and vs budget
  • Supervise the monthly reporting of balance and P&L (through One Stream)
  • Comply with controls to ensure that billing is complete and correct ensuring that the Brazilian tax rates were applied correctly.
  • Supervise the bank reconciliations, AR and AP ties vs trial balance their analysis by aging
  • Fixed assets accounting control in local currency and USD.
  • Analysis by aging of the provisions of accounts payable and outstanding invoices.
  • Analysis of the provisions of payroll
  • Design, implementation, maintenance, documentation and updating of accounting and internal control policies and procedures, integrating the requirements of other areas (Purchasing, Taxes, Financial Planning, Treasury, etc.)
  • Review the compliance of all tax returns timely based on a calendar and prepare a Summary.
  • Review the booking of tax provisions but also the payment of such taxes matches, if not ensure the booking of the adjustment.
  • Validate the reasonable of tax balances accounts.
  • Review that the bad debt reserve is proper computing and post in local ledger and report ledger.

What You’ll Need:

  • Experience in accounting Brazilian and IFRS, internal control and taxes
  • Fluency in English and Spanish desirable.
  • Excel- advanced level

Where You’ll Work:

Hybrid mode 3 days at office and 2 days home office in Brazil (Rio de Janeiro)

The Eutelsat Group treats the protection of personal data submitted to it seriously. By submitting this application, you agree to the collection and retention of your personal data by the Eutelsat Group and acknowledge notice of, and understand the terms of Eutelsat’s Privacy Policy (as amended from time to time).

This role is a Eutelsat Group job opening; all of our open roles are posted on the current OneWeb and Eutelsat websites. Please note that when you are applying, your application may be seen by both teams.

Local: Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Atuação: Presencial

Horário: Quarta a Domingo das 08h às 18h ou conforme demanda da unidade.

Sobre a Oportunidade

A Clínica Nepuga está em busca contínua de profissionais com formação em Saúde Estética pelo Nepuga para atuação em suas unidades, conforme demanda assistencial e acadêmica. Os profissionais atuarão no suporte às atividades clínicas e acadêmicas, garantindo a qualidade dos atendimentos, segurança dos procedimentos e excelência na experiência de alunos e pacientes.

Principais Atribuições

  • Acompanhar alunos durante as Vivências Clínicas, garantindo a correta execução dos procedimentos.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos protocolos técnicos e Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP’s).
  • Contribuir para a qualidade e segurança do atendimento a alunos e pacientes.
  • Realizar avaliações, anamnese e procedimentos estéticos, quando aplicável.
  • Apoiar a organização da rotina clínica, incluindo preparo de salas, materiais e controles operacionais.
  • Colaborar, quando aplicável, com treinamentos e disseminação de boas práticas técnicas e assistenciais.
  • Atuar, quando aplicável, em atividades técnicas e operacionais de maior complexidade, conforme a necessidade da unidade.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo em área da saúde.
  • Pós-graduação em Saúde Estética pelo Nepuga (concluída e sem pendências).
  • Registro ativo no Conselho Profissional, sem pendências.
  • Vivência prática em procedimentos estéticos.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial conforme demanda.

Modelo de atuação

  • Diferentes formatos de atuação poderão ser considerados, conforme a necessidade da clínica.
  • Possibilidade de participação em rotinas recorrentes ou atuações pontuais.
  • Convocações alinhadas ao calendário acadêmico e à demanda assistencial.
  • As responsabilidades poderão variar conforme o nível de atuação e escopo definido para cada oportunidade.
  • Condições contratuais e remuneração serão definidas conforme o escopo de atuação.

Informações adicionais

Esta é uma oportunidade de fluxo contínuo. A coordenação clínica realizará a seleção e o acionamento dos profissionais conforme a necessidade da unidade.

title: Maritime Technical Advisor
description:
What’s The Role

Shell is seeking a highly skilled Maritime Technical Advisor (MTA) to join our Americas Upstream Integrated Gas delivery hub. The MTA will play a critical role in ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient marine operations, supporting our Powering Progress strategy by driving operational excellence, decarbonization, and compliance across our maritime assets.

Accountabilities

  • Deliver performance excellence by understanding required business outcomes and exceeding customer expectations.
  • Act as a safety leader and risk manager, confidently making interventions on vessels, in ports, and at terminals.
  • Engage in fieldwork, travel as required and positively influence HSSE & SP and business delivery.
  • Apply causal reasoning to learn from incidents and develop corrective actions to prevent reoccurrence.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence using FIT4.
  • Ensure effective implementation of Shell Performance Framework, SEAM Standards, Specifications, Guidelines, Maritime Safety Requirements from Transport Safety Standard, Maritime Design and Engineering Standards, and Shipping and Maritime Management System.
  • Safeguard Shell’s license to operate by ensuring compliance with international and national regulations, industry standards, and best practices.
  • Provide assurance for terminals, docks, and crude oil operations with dynamically‑positioned shuttle tankers.
  • Support digital transformation and simplification initiatives to enhance operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with PTEs and SMEs throughout the Maritime Technical Function (MTF) and with Shipping and Maritime Centers of Excellence.
  • Support and provide coverage for operations across the Americas, including Raizen and LNG.
  • Participate in emergency and operational incident response as required.

Preferred Competencies & Enhanced Skills

  • Solid experience with DP vessels, including power generation, propulsion, cargo, and critical marine systems.
  • Practical exposure to testing, commissioning, and assurance of marine systems (FAT/SAT, class and contractual compliance).
  • Strong understanding of power management systems (PMS), electrical load balance, automation, and system integration.
  • Proven capability in maintenance, troubleshooting, and reliability, including dry‑dock support and major equipment overhauls.
  • Experience with marine assurance, inspections, and risk assessments, ensuring compliance with class, flag, and international regulations.
  • Ability to support engineering studies, technical specifications, and project execution across operations and new initiatives.
  • Effective communicator, able to work across operations, engineering, OEMs, shipowners, and regulators.

Leadership, Operations & Stakeholder Management

  • Skilled in coordinating multidisciplinary teams across engineering, operations, and HSE.
  • Strong communicator, adept at translating complex technical issues into operational decisions.
  • Experienced in technical reporting, audit preparation, and presenting assurance findings to senior management.
  • Effective at building relationships with shipowners, charterers, OEMs, and regulatory bodies.

What You Bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full‑time basis for anyone other than the current employer.
  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 5+ years of experience in Maritime or Naval Architecture.
  • DP Shuttle Tanker experience is a plus.
  • Maritime experience – STCW/III‑2 Chief engineer or 2nd Engineer, expertise, and credentials qualifying for assessment as Authorized Person in Maritime Safety, Technical Authority, or Subject Matter Expert within MTF.
  • Ability to prioritize, focus, and deliver must‑wins as a valued member of integrated natural teams.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English is essential.

What We Offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values‑led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance‑related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non‑birthing parents.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

We’d like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we’re working towards that goal, click here .

Shell in Brazil

Who We Are

Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 85,000 people and with operations in more than 70 countries. We use advanced technologies and take an innovative approach as we seek to help the world build a sustainable energy future.

Shell is a customer‑focused organisation, serving more than 1 million commercial and industrial customers, and around 33 million customers daily at more than 47,000 Shell‑branded retail service stations.

Our approach

Shell’s strategy is to deliver more value with less emissions as we work to become a net‑zero emissions business by 2050.

As we navigate the energy transition through the next decade, we will leverage our global footprint, the trust in our brand, and our innovation and technology capabilities to be the energy company that customers and countries choose to be their partner. We are positioning Shell to become the investment case and partner of choice through the energy transition.

Our values

At Shell, we share a set of core values – honesty, integrity, and respect for people – which underpin all the work we do. The Shell General Business Principles, Code of Conduct and Ethics and Compliance Manual help everyone at Shell act in line with these values and comply with relevant laws and regulations.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Focusing in Enrollment Management, Financial Aid, and Student Financials (Undergraduate Admissions, Curriculum & Advising, Records/Registration, Financial Aid, and Student Financials), the purpose of this role is to ensure Workday Student operations are efficient and effective while aligning with the organization’s business objectives. This position serves as a critical liaison with other Business Units and IT in translating business needs into solutions to support a seamless user experience.

Supervisory Authority

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but requires the ability to collaborate across different teams. The incumbent may occasionally provide guidance to other analysts or team members as necessary.

Nature And Scope

Operating within a dynamic and fast-paced environment, this role contributes to the organization’s operational efficiency by supporting Workday Student Information System configurations and resolving functional area-related challenges. The incumbent will engage with stakeholders to ensure that functional areas requirements are met while supporting functional area operations. The position demands a high level of analytical thinking, technical expertise, and strong communication skills and collaboration within the organization.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as the Student Information Systems partner supporting designated Student areas in Workday, such as Admissions, Academic Foundations, Curriculum, Records/Registration, Advising, and Financial Aid.
  • Provide consultation to and collaborate with operational Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in student areas, the operational staff and management.
  • Collaborate with other functional areas and technical teams to build domain knowledge and technical requirements, providing solutions and impact analysis on design decisions.
  • Serve as technical subject matter expert on current and upcoming Workday capabilities with a creative approach to solutions.
  • Stay updated on new features and technical specifications within the application’s future roadmap and support feature adoption.
  • Support business units in evaluation and testing during releases and updating functionality in order to identify opportunities to improve and optimize the use of Workday.

Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

Position

We are hiring a Software Engineer to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu on public clouds.

The quality and stability of Ubuntu is critically important, as it is available on every public cloud. You’ll work with teams across Canonical and major cloud partners to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu cloud images. You will also be a voice in communication with our users, ensuring their needs are met.

This role requires quality‑oriented software engineering in Python and a focus on software interoperability across a vast range of target releases and environments. Excellent Python skills are a key requirement, with previous contributions to open source Python projects being an advantage. The role involves creating and managing Ubuntu images; therefore, experience in configuring apt, knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous.

Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions worldwide. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. Ubuntu is used for a wide spectrum of users, from mission‑critical environments to hobbyist Ubuntu users; applicants should be ready to work with the whole spectrum of end users and help guide engineering best practices with them in mind.

Role Outline

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code, with unit and functional tests, to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and investigate to find good solutions
  • Work from home, with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self‑motivated
  • You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have extensive experience with Python on Linux
  • You have interest in and experience with two or more of the following: Ubuntu Linux systems administration, continuous integration, end‑system contract management, Debian packaging, working with public or on‑premise clouds
  • Bonus points if you have experience engaging with the open source community

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Fundada em 1986 por Paulo Martins da Luz (in memoriam), após sua brilhante trajetória profissional de 40 anos na multinacional TEXACO BRASIL S/A, onde atuou como diretor de Recursos Humanos, com o intuito de trazer para o mercado uma referência de terceirização de serviços e de mão de obra temporária, nascendo assim a PMLUZ CONSULTORIA DE RECURSOS HUMANOS LTDA especializada no fornecimento de mão de obra temporária e efetiva, fornecimento de treinamentos de equipes, administração de folhas de pagamento e gestão de pessoas.

title: Concurso Perito e Investigador salários de até R$6.280,31
description:
Edital foi autorizado para concurso público de Perito e Investigador da Policia Civil do Rio de janeiro 2019. As 685 vagas estão divididas e 118 delas para o cargo de Investigador e as restantes, 567 para Inspetor da Policia Civil.

De acordo com o Governador do Estado do Rio foram autorizadas, além dessas, mais 400 vagas para o cargo de Técnico de Necropsia (80), Auxiliar de Necropsia (60), Perito (60) e Delegado (100).

Sobretudo, ainda não foi escolhida a banca organizadora, mas sabe-se que está em fase de propostas. De acordo com a Acadepol (Academia de Policia), oito bancas estão em analise para se decidir qual delas tomará conta do certame. O Concurso de Perito e Investigador terá salários de até R$6.280,31, confira tudo sobre os cargos e a prova.

Cargos concurso Perito e Investigador

Foto divulgação: Policiais Civis em serviço.

É fundamental que o candidato fique por dentro de todas as funções para o cargo que irá concorrer à vaga. Bem, em primeiro lugar é preciso saber quais as atribuições do cargo. Então agora vamos entender as funções, atribuições e também definições dos cargos em questão.

Concurso Perito e Investigador confira os cargos:

O correto é dizer é Auxiliar Policial de Necropsia da Polícia Civil, neste caso, cargo cujo nível de escolaridade exigido é o ensino fundamental. Sendo assim, os candidatos podem esperar por grande concorrência para o concurso público, isso porque o salário é de quase R$4.000,00 aproximadamente.

Atribuições

O Auxiliar de Necropsia é responsável pelo o serviço de limpeza de cadáveres, bem como a limpeza e manutenção do local onde vai trabalhar.

2-Técnico de Necropsia

O termo correto para esse cargo é Técnico Policial de Necropsia da Polícia Civil. Todavia, esse cargo exige um nível maior de escolaridade sendo assim o candidato terá que ter o ensino médio, ou seja, não precisa ter formação de técnico de necropsia para concorrer a vaga. Contudo, esse também será um cargo muito concorrido, bem como o de Auxiliar de Necropsia, pois o salário de mais de 5 mil reais aproximadamente.

Atribuições

O Técnico de Necropsia tem as funções de fazer a autópsia dos corpos e dissecação de cadáveres, sob supervisão direta de Peritos Policiais. Uma dúvida recorrente dos candidatos do Técnico e Auxiliar de Necropsia são sobre o porte de arma e a exigência de carteira de habilitação, nos últimos concursos não se exigia a carteira de motorista, é preciso esperar o edital para concluir essa informação. No entanto, o porte de arma é inerente aos servidores da Policia Civil.

As atividades do Inspetor de Policia é estar supervisionando e atento, pois irá coordenar os superiores em assuntos técnicos especializados e fiscalizar a operação. Além disso, a função de segurança, investigações e operações policiais.

As carreiras de Inspetor Policial podem ser de âmbito operacional, sendo assim, trabalham com as inteligências policiais e também administrativas nas delegacias.

Salário para Inspetor é de R$6.711,29, ou seja, uma remuneração bastante imponente. Para o cargo é exigido nível superior, e geralmente são chamados muitos candidatos.

O Investigador de Policia tem a remuneração inicial de R$ 6.108,85 aproximadamente. De acordo com notícias o cargo de Investigador passou por uma modificação e sofreia alterações no nível de escolaridade, mas a liminar foi derrubada e ficou sendo exigido nível médio, para a alegria de todos que já estavam estudando para o concurso.

Atribuições

Exercer com supervisão e autonomia coordenação e orientação do superior suas atividades de natureza relacionadas ao transporte de autoridades garantindo total segurança, entre outras funções básicas que estão de acordo com o edital do concurso.

5-Delegado de Polícia

O Delegado de Policia que fizer o Concurso Perito e Investigador, aprovado em todas as fases do iniciará seu trabalho cumprindo os seguintes deveres:

  • Concorrer para a manutenção da ordem pública;
  • Assegurar a observância da lei;
  • Defender as instituições públicas;
  • Promover a prevenção, a apuração e a repressão das infrações penais;
  • Assegurar o exercício pleno da cidadania e das liberdades individuais;
  • Exercer atividades de nível superior, compreendendo supervisão, planejamento, coordenação e controle, no mais alto nível de hierarquia da Administração Policial do Estado, entre outras funções conforme o edital.

Etapas do concurso

A prova tem quatro etapas, visto que a primeira a provaobjetiva, com as matérias de língua portuguesa, informática, constitucional,administrativo, penal e processo penal. Além de tudo, lei de drogas e estatutodo direito civil, tudo incluído no edital.

O concurso para Perito e Investigador é bastante almejado. Passando pela prova objetiva terá as outras três avaliações: psicotécnico, exame médico e prova de capacidade física. Logo após isso, entrará para a Acadepol para passar pela investigação social.

description:
Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is recognized as one of the worldwide leaders in this field. We are actively looking for a Junior level, Mechanical Designer Technician to join our Rio de Janeiro or Sao Paulo office. As part of the Mechanical Group, the Mechanical Engineer Designer will have experience with solid bulk conveyance systems, hydraulic modelling and design of liquid bulk transmission systems, as well as utility (water / sewer / stormwater) systems. Experience in industrial complex and / or marine terminals are a plus.

About Moffatt & Nichol

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading infrastructure advisor specialising in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines. Reflecting Moffatt & Nichol’s commitment to design innovation since 1945, Engineering News-Record (ENR) has ranked the company No. 1 design firm for Marine and Port Facilities in the United States and No. 7 internationally.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists, and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, the Americas, the Middle East and Asia Pacific. The firm provides clients worldwide with customised service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in three primary practise areas—coastal, environmental, and water resources; ports and harbours; and transportation, bridges, and rail.

Duties And Responsibilities

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • To prepare a variety of designs from Agri bulk material, and mining bulk in Port Terminals or industrial plants
  • To prepare a variety of designs in waterfront facilities such as marinas, container terminals, marine oil terminals and pump stations and utilities (firefighting / water / sewer / stormwater) systems projects
  • To perform hydraulic modelling and analysis of liquid bulk transmission systems and utility (water / sewer / stormwater) systems
  • Preparing design documents (plans and specifications) with an emphasis on utility service design
  • To design other projects such as piping to support in other projects such as liquid bulk terminal and utilities which will include piping design using either Plant 3D or similar software
  • To generate proposals and develop fee estimates for PS&E packages
  • To assist with condition assessment inspections for terminals equipment and utilities infrastructure

Other Duties

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering (Desirable)
  • 2-6 years of experience in mechanical design related to bulk material handling
    • Experience in 3D piping design required
    • Plant 3D or equivalent (PDMS, PDS, etc.) experience required
  • Design experience in industrial complex and / or marine terminals is a plus
  • General understanding of process design, process flow diagram development, and piping and instrumentation diagram (P&ID) development
  • Acknowledgement in developing equipment specification, calculation, data sheets, drawings reviews and other documents related to mechanical design
  • Some planning and task management skills
  • Complete piping and pipelines stress analysis using CAESAR is a plus
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English. Spanish is an advantage
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800-171

Working Conditions

Sedentary for prolonged period of time, interact with clients, and travel occasionally.
